crossRefs.note: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Oboth
people.line: A place where the Israelites camped during the Exodus

translations.web: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.
translations.bsb: Then the Israelites set out and camped at Oboth.
translations.kjv: And the children of Israel set forward, and pitched in Oboth.
translations.asv: And the children of Israel journeyed, and encamped in Oboth.
